name: Force Platform Tick
description: Enables the platform clock tick in boot settings to adjust system timing behavior for latency tuning.

description_i18n.en: Enables the platform clock tick in boot settings to adjust system timing behavior for latency tuning.
description_i18n.de: Aktiviert den Plattform-Taktgeber im Boot-Einstellungen, um das Systemzeitverhalten für Latenzanpassungen zu optimieren.
description_i18n.fr: Active le compteur de chronologie du système dans les paramètres de démarrage pour ajuster le comportement temporel.

warnings.title: Boot configuration modified
warnings.message: This tweak updates boot settings that affect system startup timing behavior

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the Windows boot configuration by setting or removing the 'useplatformtick' value via bcdedit
